Name: Additional Lines for Muttering Farmer
Author: BackedPotatoes
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/3UwwRZ5.png[/img][/center]
﻿ ﻿
﻿
﻿This mod is an add-on to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35779]The Muttering Farmer[/url] mod. It makes your farmer talk during the most various situations!

﻿I've found The Muttering Farmer recently and it's amazing! I've been having so much fun with it. So I made my own addition to it, as YunHikari made an amazing job coding the mod so others could easily add their own lines.

I'm currently adding new stuff to this mod. I'll leave a note here once I believe I'm finished! 🐱

[left][size=3][b][img]https://i.imgur.com/l20T8HY.png[/img]﻿
[/b][/size][b]
[color=#dbb0a7]main mod:
﻿[/color]﻿﻿1.[/b] Download this mod, the file "Potatoes' Additional Lines"
[b]﻿ ﻿2.[/b] Drop the folder inside your [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b] folder
﻿﻿Done! You can now play with the new dialogue lines ^^

[b][color=#dbb0a7](optional) extra add-on about the Wizard:[/color][/b]
[b] ﻿﻿﻿1.[/b] Download the main file, "Potatoes' Additional Lines"
﻿﻿﻿[b]2.[/b] Download the additional file, "Wizard's Additional Lines"
﻿ ﻿[b]3.[/b] Drop both folders inside your [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b] folder[/left][url=http://][size=4]
[/size][/url][left][size=4][url=http://]﻿[/url][url=http://][img]https://i.imgur.com/I9kOlI4.png[/img]
[/url][url=http://]﻿
[/url][/size][list]
[*][size=2]This mod currently adds over [b]1550 [/b]lines. [/size]
[*][size=2]This mod doesn't replace Muttering Farmer's original lines, only adds new ones.[/size]
[/list][b][size=3]
﻿✨[color=#ea9999]﻿[/color][color=#f6b26b]NPC's and Relationships[/color]﻿
[/size][/b][list]
[*]Lines for [b]Spouses + Dating + Divorced NPCs.[/b]
[*][size=2]Lines for your [b]pet [/b]and [b]horse![/b][/size]
[*]Unique [b]greetings for NPCs[/b] (e.g., warmer responses the more hearts the farmer has with the villagers).
[*][b]Time conditions[/b] for greetings (e.g., "good morning" when early.).
[/list] [size=3]﻿﻿✨﻿[b][color=#f6b26b]Occasions[/color][/b]﻿[b][/b] [/size][list]
[*]Lines about [b]festivals [/b](Flower Dance, New Year, etc.) and [b]events [/b](Grandpa's visit, special orders, quests, etc.).
[*]Monologue about the [b]seasons[/b]!
[*]Lines for [b]locations,[/b] outdoors[b] [/b]and indoors.
[*]Lines when it's [b]near 2 a.m.[/b] or the farmer might pass out.
[/list][b][size=3] ﻿﻿﻿✨﻿[color=#f6b26b]Items and Combat[/color]﻿[/size][/b][list]
[*][size=2]Lines for [b]items [/b](sunflowers, sap, etc.) and [b]categories [/b](trash, flowers, etc.).[/size]
[*]Additional lines for [b]combat, inventory, and more.[/b]
[*]Monologue about [b]tools [/b](pickaxe, hoe, etc.) and [b]learning how to use them.[/b]
[/list][size=2][b]
[/b][/size][size=3] ﻿✨ [b][color=#f6b26b]Other Mods Additions[/color]﻿
[/b][/size][list]
[*]All the topics mentioned above have [b]SVE [/b]additions! [size=2]If you don't[/size] play with SVE, it won't affect your game! ^—^
[*][b]Romanceable Rasmodius[/b] optional file! 
[/list]
This mod adds a lot. If you want a very detailed list of everything this mod adds, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/3950]see this post.[/url]﻿

[size=2][img]https://i.imgur.com/hlehbfb.png[/img][/size]

[list]
[*][size=2]You can disable a group of lines (spouses lines, location lines, etc.) through the Muttering Farmer's options, using the [b]GMCM[/b]﻿.[/size]
[*][size=2]Alternative file without horse lines, for players who use the [b]Tractor Mod[/b].[/size]
[*][size=2]You can edit, add or delete any lines in the [b]default.json[/b] file. As how to do so, see the original [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35779]mod's tutorial[/url]﻿ or my mod's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/3961]article.[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=2][b]Spanish translation[/b] available for download, made by [url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/profile/191819634-hayakobuu/]hayakobuu[/url]![/size]
[/list][size=2]
[/size][b][size=3] ﻿✨ [color=#f6b26b]Romanceable Rasmodius Option!
[/color][/size][/b] ﻿Now there's an optional file for players who use mods that turn the Wizard into a dating candidate! It has around [b]200[/b] lines related to Magnus. Lines about[b] gifts[/b], special lines upon [b]entering his tower[/b], [b]quests [/b]with him, [b]dating [/b]+ [b]spouse [/b]+ [b]divorced [/b]lines, and more![/left]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/KdwLUol.png[/img]

[list]
[*]This mod's keys are compatible with any Muttering Farmer's add-on, like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40079]HelloThere[/url]﻿! 
[*]Muttering Farmer is compatible with pretty much any mod out there, and so are any of its add-ons.
[/list][color=#dbb0a7][b]compatibility of the wizard's addition:[/b]
[/color][list]
[*][color=#f4f4f4]It's compatible with any Rasmodius' mod (SVE, Romanceable Rasmodius, RRRR, etc.). For vanilla Rasmodius, you can still download it for a close but platonic relationship. [/color]
[*][color=#f4f4f4]It's [b]not [/b]compatible with Female Rasmodius, but you can edit the file for it to work.[/color]
[*][color=#f4f4f4]﻿﻿Compatible with [b]multiple spouses[/b].[/color]
[*][color=#f4f4f4]It won't interfere with your gameplay if you don't marry him in one of your saves.[/color]
[*][color=#f4f4f4]Here's the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/3956]FAQ[/url]﻿ about the addition.[/color]
[/list]


If you like my mods, you can support my work by buying me a [url=https://ko-fi.com/backedpotatoes]coffee[/url]!🐱[size=2]
[/size]
